projects.title: Microsoft Encarta 97 static recompilation
projects.platform: Windows x86 → Windows 10/11; Linux via Wine; macOS via CrossOver (untested)
projects.status: Alpha, with no tagged release. The README reports that it boots, browses articles, runs MindMaze, and displays images and video; 9/9 conformance checks pass when the original discs are available.
projects.summary: Statically recompiles the English two-disc Encarta 97 Win32 application into C for modern systems. It remains a hybrid build that calls selected Microsoft runtime libraries; users supply their own original disc data.

projects.title: Dance eJay 1 & 2 engine recompilation
projects.status: Alpha and unreleased. The project reports that Dance eJay 2's arrangement page and playback work; Dance eJay 1 streams audio, while its sampler remains silent.
projects.summary: Recompiles the PXD Musicsoft audio engine behind two Windows music-making applications, bridging the 16-bit engine and 32-bit code to C while retaining the Visual Basic front ends. Users provide their original discs.
projects.strategy: Static recompilation of the audio engine

projects.title: Microsoft Bob Win16 recompilation
projects.status: Bring-up stage. The project reports that the original startup path and Jet databases execute in its host; a first rendered application frame is not yet documented.
projects.summary: Lifts Microsoft Bob's Win16 NE application and database-related modules into C, with replacement runtime work for Win16, Jet, and WinG dependencies. Requires a user-owned copy of the original application.

projects.title: Apple II DeskTop ProDOS disassembly
projects.status: Active annotated disassembly. The project describes reverse engineering the ProDOS desktop suite to understand it, fix bugs, and add features.
projects.summary: Source reconstruction work on Apple II DeskTop, a Finder-like graphical shell for ProDOS. The repository publishes annotated assembly and supports continued fixes and enhancements for the original platform.

projects.title: RNC ProPack source decompilation
projects.status: Work in progress. The repository identifies the code as a decompilation of the DOS compression utility and documents pack, unpack, search, and extract operations.
projects.summary: Decompiled C source for RNC ProPack, a standalone DOS file compression utility. This is a software-tool reconstruction rather than a game project.
